{{Quote|Unless those walls are made from ''Mandalorian iron'', this battle isn't going to last long!|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="The Feral Queen">{{TCWComicCite|6.21|The Feral Queen}}</ref>}}
The '''Royal Felacatian Palace''' was a large multilevel structure on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felacat]] that acted as home to the planet's royal family.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], while the [[Felacatian]] [[Miaria Prrt]] was [[Queen/Legends|Queen]], Felacat was invaded by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems's]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]], who besieged the palace using [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] supported by [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]]. The queen sent multiple communications to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], with whom the Felacat were allied, asking for reinforcements against the Separatists but was told no reinforcements were available to be sent. Six [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], three [[Standard day/Legends|days]] and seven [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] after the siege began, [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] arrived on Felacat and landed on the palace's upper level alone with her [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R7-A7/Legends|R7-A7]], to provide aid but was mistaken for a Separatist [[Spy/Legends|spy]] by the guards and brought before the queen. Miaria recognized the Jedi as Republic aid but argued with her over the lateness of her arrival before the pair was interrupted by super battle droids breaching the palace's main gate, causing the palace guard to panic and flee. Ahsoka and the queen worked together to fend off the droids with the queen assuming her beast form. This show of courage also motivated the guard, who themselves transformed and together with the Jedi fought off the droids, ending the siege on the palace.<ref name="The Feral Queen" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Royal Felacatian Palace was created by writer [[Robin Etherington]] and drawn by [[Andres Ponce]] for the short comic ''[[The Feral Queen]]'', in which it was the main setting. The comic was published in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.21|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.21]]''.<ref name="The Feral Queen" />
